description: Connect your Diagno account to review performance and diagnostics across the solar and battery sites you can access. Compare recent site performance, inspect equipment and data sources, review eligible Diagno issues, and explore interval telemetry or daily statistics. Access is read-only and follows your Diagno organisation and portfolio permissions. Human-reviewed issues are available only for eligible roles and PRO sites; no issues does not mean a BASIC site has no problems.
